For a given “scope” value, this event is sent after a successful sync (note that every login triggers a sync). It is sent only if the latest sending was more than 24 hours ago for this user on this device.Example 1 (in the same installation): 1 - I log in with my first account  2 - A vault_report event is triggered (assuming it was not triggered on this installation by this user within the past 24 hours) 3 - I log out 4 - I log in with my second account  5 - A vault_report is triggered (assuming it was not triggered on this installation by this user within the past 24 hours) Example 2 (with the same user account): 1 - I log in with my first device  2 - A vault_report event is triggered  3 - I log out 4 - I log in with my second device  5 - A vault_report is triggered  Item type grouping: passwords [item_type = credential] secure_notes [item_type = secure_note] payments [item_type in (credit_card, paypal, bank_statement)] personal_info [item_type in (identity, email, phone, address, company, website)] ids [item_type in (id_card, social_security, driver_licence , passport, fiscal_statement)].WARNING: The structure shown here might not be fully implemented. When a user starts, completes, or has an error during the change or reset master password flow. The start of the flow corresponds to the first page prompting a user to change the master password. If the flow_step is "error", include the error property. When resetting the master password, there will also be a "forget_master_password" event preceding the start of the change_master_password flow. The flow is "cancelled" when the user exits out of the entire change flow (not simply when they go back to a previous change master password page). On Web, only at successful change, we send whether the MP was leaked prior to its change.

When the user cancels his plan in his B2C account management panel. The steps in the cancel flow : Start when the cancel flow begins. Success_cancel when the subscription is cancelled and the user is out of policy for refund. Success_refund when the subscription is cancelled and refunded. Success_cancel_and_error_refund when the subscription is cancelled and refund does not go through because of an error. Contact_support when the user clicks on contact support after having an error with refund. Abandon when the user quits and does not complete the cancellation flow. In the cancelation survey, if the user picks any other answer than other_reasons, then other_reasons will be NULL. Figma : https://www.figma.com/file/DpoyPciwE3SvyZQRiBuxeh/B2C-Subscription-Self-Service?node-id=2849%3A101657
